svg.desc: Lazik Hospital LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT Retina Consultancy Center Company COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2009 14.5 million EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2009, this 370 m2 specialized Retina Center in Heliopolis was developed for the Retina Consultant Center. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management. The multidisciplinary services covered urban planning & design, landscape design, architectural design, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
